fc2bf92c55.q: How did Eric Newcomer transition from working at Bloomberg to building an independent newsletter and media company?
fc2bf92c55.a: After six years at Bloomberg, Newcomer wanted to do something riskier and didn't want that to be the only thing he did for the rest of his career. He was inspired by Substack as an emerging platform and had seen subscription business models work at The Information and Bloomberg. He quit, announced his Substack newsletter, and it performed well early on, becoming one of the top 10 tech Substacks. He found his strength in reaching venture capital firms and founders who were doing the work, and eventually events became an even larger share of revenue beyond subscriptions.

1b3e522dcb.q: What is the VC Sentiment Report and how does Eric Newcomer use it to make predictions about venture capital?
1b3e522dcb.a: Newcomer recently rolled out a VC Sentiment Report where they anonymously interview venture capitalists including current and former members of the Midas List and people who run their own firms. The report gets a read on how close the bubble is, how far away it is, and what companies VCs are excited about right now. Newcomer uses this model of being plugged into what's happening through reporting and talking to many plugged-in people to make good predictions and understand where industry leaders' heads are at.

2cc111b06b.q: How does Newcomer differentiate its media approach from traditional feature-style magazine reporting?
2cc111b06b.a: Newcomer is transparent about having a point of view and opinion when the team can't keep it to themselves, stating directly what they think rather than sneaking bias in through reporting. The publication prioritizes getting great facts and information first, and when they have an opinion they say it directly so readers can easily agree or disagree. This contrasts with older feature-style magazine reporting where publications might cobble together negative quotes without directly stating their perspective, making it harder for readers to understand the underlying bias.

7cd8ebe05c.q: What does Eric Newcomer see as the key trend in building independent media businesses in the digital age?
7cd8ebe05c.a: Newcomer believes the key trend is that people prefer to build relationships with other humans rather than brands. Thanks to YouTube, TikTok, and other digital platforms, it is now possible to build a full-fledged media business where people decide whether they trust that specific person or not. The advantage is that no matter how much the publication scales, people know Newcomer is to blame if something goes wrong and he remains answerable and reachable, making him accountable to readers.
